subject: pe
title: Warm-Up & Cool-Down: Full Routine
welcome_lead: Put it all together — a 10-minute routine you can use anywhere.
meta_desc: KS3 PE: full warm-up + cool-down routine.
final_note: Practice the routine until it's automatic.

concepts.def: Light hop drill that raises pulse.
Step forward, knee bent — leg drill.

walkthroughs.body_html: Raise pulse, Activate muscles, Mobilise joints, Potentiate with sport-specific moves.
1 min jog, 1 min skipping, 1 min leg swings + shoulder rolls, 1 min lunges + planks, 1 min sport-specific drill (e.g. ball passes).
2 min walk, stretches for quads, hamstrings, calves, chest, shoulders. Sip water. Done!
